THE DRUID PREVIEW

WoW Forever Druid talents by tree

52 talents · 15 new · 33 changed

Explore WoW Forever Druid talents form by form. Balance gains Eclipse and Nature's Splendor before Moonkin Form, Feral Combat adds Primal Bite and ends in Berserk, and Restoration ends in Wild Growth. Linked names lead to recorded ranks; new and changed labels describe the data without judging it.

Balance talents

New: Genesis, Nature's Majesty, Nature's Splendor, Overgrowth, Eclipse.

Final row: Moonkin Form. Requires 30 points in earlier Balance rows, plus any listed prerequisite.

Feral Combat talents

New: Shifting Power, Primal Bite, Improved Shifting Power, Predatory Instincts, Natural Reaction, Rend and Tear, Berserk.

Final row: Berserk. Requires 30 points in earlier Feral Combat rows, plus any listed prerequisite.

Restoration talents

New: Gift of the Earthmother, Living Spirit, Wild Growth.

Final row: Wild Growth. Requires 30 points in earlier Restoration rows, plus any listed prerequisite.

WoW Forever Druid abilities: what changed outside the talents

4 abilities

Some of the biggest Druid changes are trained spells rather than talents. These 4 notes come from the level 60 Beta spellbook; each one links to the talents that reference it. Ranks and levels can still change before launch.

Omen of Clarity and Nature's GraspNow trainable

Both are trainable now instead of talents in the Balance tab: Nature's Grasp at level 10 and the passive Omen of Clarity at level 20.

Nature's Grasp, Omen of Clarity

ReviveNew

An out-of-combat resurrection with a 10 sec cast. Rebirth keeps its 30 min cooldown.

LacerateNew

The bear bleed is a baseline Feral ability: 15 Rage, Bear or Dire Bear Form. Three ranks, trained at 42, 50 and 58. Shredding Attacks reduces its Rage cost.

Shifting Power

Cure PoisonUnchanged

Still present at level 14 through the Power over Poison quest, as in Classic. The current record marks it as a book, quest or drop; High Order Skyborne can take that quest according to published notes.

Racial abilities are listed separately on the WoW Forever racials page; they cost no talent points. Every class’s changes are collected on the WoW Forever abilities page.

How to plan WoW Forever Druid talents

Plan WoW Forever Druid talents around the form you fight in. Primal Bite and Natural Reaction require Bear Form or Dire Bear Form, Berserk and Predatory Strikes also count in Cat Form, and Shifting Power converts Mana into Energy while Cat Form is active. Pick your main tree first, then trace its prerequisites backwards.

Set your level and budget

Choose the level first; it caps WoW Forever Druid talents at 21 points for level 30 and 51 for level 60, shared by all three trees. Moonkin Form, Berserk and Wild Growth each need 30 points in earlier rows of their tree, so a 51-point plan reaches one of them with 20 points to spare; a 21-point plan reaches none.

Learn and refund ranks

A click learns a rank; right-click or Shift-click refunds it; on touch, tap to inspect and again to learn. Locked WoW Forever Druid talents show what they wait for: Primal Bite needs 15 Feral Combat points and a bear form, Eclipse 20 in Balance, and Swiftmend 15 in Restoration. Keyboard users focus with Tab and learn with Enter or Space.

Reach the later rows

Each later row needs 5 more points in earlier rows of the same tree. Feral Combat places these WoW Forever Druid talents late: Shifting Power in row four, Improved Shifting Power and Predatory Instincts in row five, and Rend and Tear in row six. Refund the dependant before its prerequisite, or reset the tree.

Save and share WoW Forever Druid talents

A Druid keeps more than one plan: a Balance caster spread, a bear-or-cat Feral Combat layout, a Restoration healing build. Your current allocation of WoW Forever Druid talents saves as one draft; open My builds, name a setup such as Feral 31/20 and choose Save build to keep several. Names stay on this device.

Copy build gives WoW Forever Druid talents a link that stores class, level, every rank and data version, so a friend opens your exact Primal Bite or Wild Growth path. Select the link in the field if copying fails, or use Share where your device offers it. Local saves stay put, so keep a link before clearing browser data.

WoW Forever Druid talents FAQ

Answers for preview changes, source coverage and saved setups.

How do WoW Forever Druid talents differ from Classic?+

This preview marks 15 Druid talents new and 33 changed. Thick Hide now adds base Armor per level in your forms, Nature's Grace is now 10% haste instead of a 0.5 sec cut, and Feral Charge gains a cat version. Switch on Compare to Classic to see the old text beside the new.

Are all talent ranks verified?+

This snapshot of WoW Forever Druid talents records 148 rank descriptions and leaves 0 slots empty. Tranquil Spirit, Improved Regrowth and Thick Hide, plus Genesis, Moonfury and Gift of Nature, now have every rank written. The full reference still marks any later gap.

Can I restore WoW Forever Druid talents on another device?+

Yes. Open the copied build link in the other browser; it restores class, level and every point, whether a 31-point Feral Combat plan or a Restoration layout. Drafts and named saves stay on the device that created them. An older link explains the data change and keeps its address so it can still be copied.

Are these the best WoW Forever Druid talents?+

No. Budget, row gates and prerequisites are what the calculator checks; it does not simulate damage, healing or threat. Compare WoW Forever Druid talents by reading the recorded effects: Predatory Strikes scales with your level, Rend and Tear counts on Bleeding targets. The finished build still needs an in-game test.
